artists.source_line: 🎉 *INTERNATIONAL GALA DANCE BOAT “REGINA DANUBIA meets DDF”* 🎉 Germany Dance Festival

features.rationale: The description says the weekend combines intensive workshops with parties and a boat trip.
The event is a dance cruise on the Danube riverboat Regina Danubia.

features.quote: you dance on a real Danube riverboat
features.rationale: Dancing takes place on a riverboat during the Danube dance boat trip.
An afterparty is listed for the Saturday schedule after the boat trip, back at the Redoute Theater.
The description recommends hotels in Passau without stating that accommodation is part of the pass.
